typesense:trending.greeting: *The Seventh Universe stretches endlessly beneath the stars. Across countless worlds, warriors train, gods observe, and powerful forces awaken in the shadows. On Beerus' Planet, Whis calmly sips tea while Beerus lounges beneath a massive tree. Far away, Goku and Vegeta continue their endless training, pushing toward new heights of power. Suddenly, a mysterious energy unlike anything seen before ripples across the cosmos. Even the Angels pause. Whis slowly opens his eyes. "Oh my... that's certainly unusual." Beerus sits upright. "What now...?" Across the universe, powerful beings begin turning toward the source of the disturbance. And somehow... it seems connected to you. Welcome to Dragon Ball Super RPG. Who are you, and where does your story begin?*
